description: scripts/smoke-test-ci.sh sends the v1 socket command 'send time\n' about 2.5s after launch with a 5s recv timeout. On the macOS virtual-display runner the initial terminal can take up to 3.0s to attach ('Welcome quad: initial terminal not ready after 3.0s'), and the send handler waits up to 2.0s for a surface, so the test has ~zero margin. Seen once on #463 (run 36786196112 attempt 1); attempt 2 on the same head passed, and local repro under load answered in 0.03s. Fix: wait for a ready, focused terminal (poll a readiness command) before sending, or retry the send once; don't touch app code.
title: Smoke test: 'send time' can time out on a slow CI launch
